That id resolves to the single tei:anchor directly before פְּנֵי (JLPTEI-3 'Comments and Notes': 'A target attribute references the point in the text where the note applies'). targetEnd is optional in the guidelines ('may also be used'). The prior reader explicitly accepted a single anchor and only recommended an end anchor, so its absence is not a violation. No j:condition is needed because the note applies wherever the module is transcluded.

The reusable module (urn:…prayer:misod_chakhamim) contains no ark directive. That is correct: the open-ark and close-ark directives belong to this service order and are encoded in the running order on either side of the transclusion (see the instructions below). They should not be moved into the canonical prayer.

The prior review's issue (ark-opening rubric not encoded) and its two unresolved items (missing minyan/repetition condition, missing heading) all came from not seeing the running order. They are answered by context that exists. The documentary order context has, in sequence: the description note חֲזָרַת הַתְּפִלָּה לִשְׁלִיחַ צִבּוּר., the instruction note פותחים הארון., a transclusion of …/repetition/avot/open, a transclusion of prayer:misod_chakhamim, the instruction note סוגרים הארון., the description note ע״ס א״ב., and a transclusion of poem:at_chil_yom_pequddah. That is the order printed on s124.

Full repetition scope in the expanded spine: div xml:id=section_morning_repetition holds j:conditional section_morning_repetition_condition, a j:all of recitation.repetition=true and quorum.minyan=true. This is the outermost place the condition can be stated, with no instruction note, as JLPTEI-3 'Conditions on a running order' requires. Inside it, j:declare section_morning_repetition_settings fixes repetition=true, silent=false and minyan=true, as required when a condition fixes a feature to a single value. That is followed by the bilingual tei:head (he חזרת התפלה לשליח צבור / en Repetition of the Amidah), then the instruction פותחים הארון., the transclusion of avot/open, the transclusion of misod_chakhamim, and the instruction סוגרים הארון.

Scopes are properly closed. j:endDeclare target=#section_morning_repetition_settings is the last child of the inner div, and j:endConditional target=#section_morning_repetition_condition follows that div. The same holds for the nested scopes: section_repetition_attah_hu_custom_condition, section_morning_repetition_weekday_poems_condition, section_metz_tair_vetaria_expanded_1/2_condition, section_morning_repetition_shabbat_poems_condition and section_expanded_metz_kol_1/2_condition each have an endConditional naming their own id. All ids are local and unique in the excerpt.

The ark directives are directives under JLPTEI-3 'Kinds of rubric' ('The Ark is opened' is the example given): tei:note type=instruction placed where the action applies and printed wherever that place is reached. Each artifact encodes them once, in the right place: open before Avot, close after Misod. They are not encoded inside the module. No @rend is needed.

The heading is encoded once in each artifact: as tei:note type=description in the documentary index, and as tei:head inside the conditioned div in the spine, after the j:conditional. That matches the rule that a description goes 'first inside the passage's scope, after the j:conditional'. The running header at the top of the page (no period) is page furniture and is correctly not encoded.
